definitions.explanation: The act of interacting and maintaining relationships with other people. Can refer to one's general ability or willingness to socialize.

examples.japanese: {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: When you start working, social obligations increase.
He's good with people and can quickly become friends with anyone.

notes:
USAGE:
{人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い is a common word for describing how well or how much one socializes. It often appears with ⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧ (bad at), ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ (good at), or ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide, extensive).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ (to be bad at socializing)
- {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (to be sociable)
- {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (to have a wide social circle)
- {人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid socializing)
